milestone.title: Agent session continuity: plan diff, AC traceability, step claim/lease

intent.outcome: Agents can see plan deltas since a handoff or timestamp, audit a milestone's AC/step/test linkage before complete, and optionally claim steps so mp next skips in-flight work. Reviewers get machine-readable trace artifacts to pair with M64 execution reports.

problem.description: Three recurring gaps from review and dogfooding: (1) Context loss between agent sessions — handoff exists but there is no crisp 'what changed in the plan since last time?' artifact. (2) Semantic drift — specs and code diverge while mechanical gates pass; reviewers need a structured AC→verification→step map, not grep. (3) Parallel or overlapping agent runs clobber milestone files — documented in AGENTS.md and backlog B-26 but not enforced; --if-updated does not cover step add chains. These are agent-facing (mp) capabilities that complement M64's review queue without automating review judgment.

in_scope: mp plan diff: read-only diff of plan.toml + milestone files since --since <iso>, --since-handoff, or --git <ref>; JSON + optional markdown summary grouped by milestone
Extend mp execution handoff or add mp handoff show to surface last diff pointer / changed milestone ids

mp milestone trace <id>: per-milestone report — each AC with verification + evidence status; each step with tests classify result; gaps (AC uncovered, manual where runnable exists, steps without tests)
Step claim/lease: fields on step (claimed_by, claimed_at, lease_expires_at) or sidecar; mp milestone step claim|release <M> <S> [--lease <duration>]
mp next and mp path: skip steps with active non-expired claims; surface claim owner in JSON
Integration tests for diff, trace, and claim lifecycle
out_of_scope: LLM-based spec drift detection (advisory heuristics only)
Hard blocking writes when step claimed by another agent (lease is soft-skip for mp next unless config strict)
File locks or merge on concurrent writes (B-20 deferred)
raul surface for these commands (raul can shell out later)

acceptance_criteria.description: mp plan diff --since-handoff lists changed milestones and field-level summary; exits 0 on clean tree
mp milestone trace <id> reports AC coverage gaps and step test classification
step claim + release works; mp next skips actively claimed steps; expired leases ignored

open_questions.question: Store claim fields inline on Step struct vs annotations sidecar?
open_questions.answer: Suggestion: inline on Step in milestone TOML — visible in mp show, no join logic; clears on step complete.

steps.action: Implement mp plan diff with --since-handoff, --since <iso>, and --git <ref>; JSON output grouped by milestone with changed fields summary
steps.done_when: mp plan diff --since-handoff runs and lists changes

steps.action: Surface changed milestone ids on mp execution handoff and add mp handoff show read command pointing at last diff context
steps.done_when: handoff records changes; handoff show returns them

steps.action: Implement mp milestone trace <id>: AC list with verification/evidence, step tests with ac_verify classify, gap rows for uncovered ACs and missing tests
steps.done_when: trace report matches fixture milestone gaps

steps.action: Add step claim fields to model (claimed_by, claimed_at, lease_expires_at); mp milestone step claim and step release commands
steps.done_when: claim and release persist on step

steps.action: Update mp next and mp path to skip non-expired claimed steps; include claim metadata in JSON
steps.done_when: mp next skips claimed step; expired lease ignored

steps.action: Document plan diff, handoff show, milestone trace, and step claim in MP-COMMANDS.md
